Usage: hm <command> [options]

Environment
  clean                 Collect what environments that no longer exist left behind
  describe              Show everything that defines the current project
  doctor                Diagnose the machine and the current project
  down                  Stop and remove containers, networks, images, and volumes (-v)
  launch                Open the project in the browser
  list                  List every Dockergento environment on this machine
  logs                  Show the logs of the project, or of the services named
  post-start            Apply what the platform needs after an environment comes up
  proxy                 The global proxy, so several projects can be up at once
  rebuild               Rebuild docker services with current configuration
  restart               Restart docker services
  setup                 Dockerize magento project
  share                 Give this project a temporary public address
  start                 Start docker services
  stop                  Stop docker services
  tui                   Open the dashboard: every environment on this machine, on one screen
  tunnel                Open a temporary way in to a service that is not routed by name
  worktree              An environment per branch, with its own address and data

Magento
  composer              Execute composer inside php container
  grunt                 Prepare grunt configuration and compile theme styles using grunt
  install               Execute setup:install Magento command with custom config
  magento               Execute Magento console commands
  n98-magerun           Execute n98-magerun tool
  npm                   Execute npm commands into node container
  purge                 Remove all magento generated code (caches, generated, static, view_preprocessed)
  test-integration      Execute your magento integration tests
  test-unit             Execute your magento unit test

Database
  db                    Named copies of this project's database
  dbeaver               Open DBeaver on this project's database
  masquerade            Execute masquerade tool. 'hm masquerade --help' to view more info. 
  mysql                 Execute mysql command into container
  mysqldump             Execute mysqldump command into container
  sequelace             Open Sequel Ace on this project's database
  tableplus             Open TablePlus on this project's database
  transfer-db           Transfer database form external source to this project

Files
  copy-from-container   (Mac only) Copy and overwrite container content into host
  copy-to-container     (Mac only) Copy and overwrite host content into container
  transfer-media        Transfer multimedia recurses form external source to this project

Tools
  bash                  Connect into container using bash [Default container: php]
  cloud-login           Magento Cloud Login
  cloud                 Magento Cloud Cli
  compatibility         Check Magento version compatibility
  config-env            Launch config set of project for local environment
  create-project        Create new magento project inside current directory
  debug-off             Disable xDebug
  debug-on              Enable xDebug
  docker-compose        Execute docker compose using configuration for your machine
  docker-stop-all       Stop all running containers
  exec                  Execute a command in a running container [Default container: php]
  set-host              Set host name in /etc/hosts and core_config_data
  ssl                   Install SSL certificates for docker environment
  varnish-off           Turn off varnish service
  varnish-on            Turn on varnish service
  verify                Run whatever code checks this project has installed
  web                   Bring up the web interface and print the link to open it

Versions
  switch                Install another release (2.0 or later) in place of this hm
  update                Replace this hm with the newest release, when there is a newer one
  version               Show the version of the tool, Docker and Compose

AI tools
  ai-context            Write the project context an agent reads before it starts
  ai-doctor             Show what AI tooling this project has and whether it is up to date
  ai-init               Initialize AI tools configuration (skills/agents) via interactive wizard
  ai-pull               Download/update AI tools (skills/agents) from configured repositories
  ai-reset              Remove downloaded AI tools while preserving custom skills/agents
  mcp                   Read-only tools for agents, over the Model Context Protocol
  permissions           Print the permission configuration an agent should be given

Examples
  hm start                      Bring the environment up
  hm magento cache:clean        Run a Magento command
  hm mysql -i dump.sql          Import a database dump
  hm describe                   Show what this project is
  hm doctor                     Diagnose the machine and the project

Global options
  --json                Force machine readable JSON output
  --no-json             Force human readable text output
  --yes                 Never ask questions: use defaults or fail with an actionable error
  --force               Run a command refused from a git worktree (one invocation only)
  --no-color            Never colour the output (see also NO_COLOR)

Run hm <command> --help for details on a single command.
